lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਢਕਣ ਕੂ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem patolaa tai sahi ditaa dhakan koo pat meree ||
lines.translation: O Husband Lord, You have given me the silk gown of Your Love to cover and protect my honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਈ ਮੈਡਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: daanaa beenaa saaee maidaa naanak saar na jaanaa teree ||1||
lines.translation: You are all-wise and all-knowing, O my Master; Nanak: I have not appreciated Your value, Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈਡੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਧਮੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taidai simaran habh kichh ladham bikham na ditham koee ||
lines.translation: By Your meditative remembrance, I have found everything; nothing seems difficult to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis pat rakhai sachaa saahib naanak met na sakai koee ||2||
lines.translation: One whose honor the True Lord Master has preserved - O Nanak, no one can dishonor him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਦਯਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: hovai sukh ghanaa day dhiaaiai ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord, there comes a great peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: va(n)njai rogaa ghaan har gun gaaiai ||
lines.translation: Multitudes of illnesses vanish, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਠਾਢਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar varatai thaadh prabh chit aaiai ||
lines.translation: Utter peace pervades within, when God comes to mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran hovai aas naai ma(n)n vasaaiai ||
lines.translation: One's hopes are fulfilled, when one's mind is filled with the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: koi na lagai bighan aap gavaaiai ||
lines.translation: No obstacles stand in the way, when one eliminates his self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan padaarath mat gur te paaiai ||
lines.translation: The intellect attains the blessing of spiritual wisdom from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin paae sabhe thok jis aap divaaiai ||
lines.translation: He receives everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਐ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sabhanaa kaa khasam sabh teree chhaaiai ||8||
lines.translation: You are the Lord and Master of all; all are under Your Protection. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਤਰੰਦੜੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਖੋਜੁ ਨ ਖੁੰਭੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadee tara(n)daRee maidaa khoj na khu(n)bhai ma(n)jh muhabat teree ||
lines.translation: Crossing the stream, my foot does not get stuck - I am filled with love for You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਚਰਣੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਹੀਅੜਾ ਸੀਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਬੇੜੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tau sah charanee maidaa heeaRaa seetam har naanak tulahaa beRee ||1||
lines.translation: O Lord, my heart is attached to Your Feet; the Lord is Nanak's raft and boat. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਦਿਸੰਦੜਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵੰਞੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਾਡੜੇ ਸੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa disa(n)daRiaa duramat va(n)njai mitr asaadaRe seee ||
lines.translation: The sight of them banishes my evil-mindedness; they are my only true friends.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hau dhoodhedee jag sabaaiaa jan naanak virale keee ||2||
lines.translation: I have searched the whole world; O servant Nanak, how rare are such persons! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavai saahib chit teriaa bhagataa dithiaa ||
lines.translation: You come to mind, O Lord and Master, when I behold Your devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee kateeai mail saadhasa(n)g vuthiaa ||
lines.translation: The filth of my mind is removed, when I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran bhau kateeai jan kaa sabad jap ||
lines.translation: The fear of birth and death is dispelled, meditating on the Word of His humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਖੋਲਨੑਿ ਸੰਤ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਛਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan kholanhi sa(n)t doot sabh jaahi chhap ||
lines.translation: The Saints untie the bonds, and all the demons are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਨੑਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis siu laainhi ra(n)g jis dee sabh dhaareeaa ||
lines.translation: They inspire us to love Him, the One who established the entire universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚੀ ਹੂੰ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: oochee hoo(n) oochaa thaan agam apaareeaa ||
lines.translation: The seat of the inaccessible and infinite Lord is the highest of the high.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain dinas kar joR saas saas dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, with each and every breath, meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਭਗਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: jaa aape hoi daiaal taa(n) bhagat sa(n)g paaeeai ||9||
lines.translation: When the Lord Himself becomes merciful, then we attain the Society of His devotees. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਨੜੈ ਹੁੰਮਸ ਧੁੰਮਸ ਕੂਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਰਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: baar vidaanaRai hu(n)mas dhu(n)mas kookaa paeeaa raahee ||
lines.translation: In this wondrous forest of the world, there is chaos and confusion; shrieks emanate from the highways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਗੜੀ ਡੋਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tau sah setee lagaRee doree naanak anad setee ban gaahee ||1||
lines.translation: I am in love with You, O my Husband Lord; O Nanak, I cross the jungle joyfully. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬੈਸਕ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee baisak tinhaa sa(n)g jin sa(n)g japeeai naau ||
lines.translation: The true society is the company of those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tinh sa(n)g sa(n)g na keechaee naanak jinaa aapanaa suaau ||2||
lines.translation: Do not associate with those, O Nanak, who look out only for their own interests. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa velaa paravaan jit satigur bhetiaa ||
lines.translation: Approved is that time, when one meets the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਤੇਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoaa saadhoo sa(n)g phir dookh na tetiaa ||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he does not suffer pain again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਲੇਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaiaa nihachal thaan phir garabh na letiaa ||
lines.translation: When he attains the eternal place, he does not have to enter the womb again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਇਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadaree aaiaa ik sagal brahametiaa ||
lines.translation: He comes to see the One God everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੇਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tat giaan laai dhiaan drisat sametiaa ||
lines.translation: He focuses his meditation on the essence of spiritual wisdom, and withdraws his attention from other sights.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੋਲੇਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabho japeeai jaap j mukhahu boletiaa ||
lines.translation: All chants are chanted by one who chants them with his mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੇਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukame bujh nihaal sukh sukhetiaa ||
lines.translation: Realizing the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he becomes happy, and he is filled with peace and tranquility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਏ ਸੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਖੋਟਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: parakh khajaanai paae se bahuR na khotiaa ||10||
lines.translation: Those who are assayed, and placed in the Lord's treasury, are not declared counterfeit again. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੋਹੇ ਜੰਬੂਰ ਖਵੇ ਨ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗਾਖੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichhohe ja(n)boor khave na va(n)njan gaakhaRe ||
lines.translation: The pincers of separation are so painful to endure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਮਿਲੰਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: je so dhanee mila(n)n naanak sukh sa(n)booh sach ||1||
lines.translation: If only the Master would come to meet me! O Nanak, I would then obtain all the true comforts. ||1||
